recent_models.release_evidence: Publisher model card explicitly lists07/16/2026; same-day NVIDIA publisher announcement states the release.
recent_models.architecture: Ministral3 bidirectional encoder; 1B variant produced by structured pruning/distillation of a3B backbone;8B variant adapts Ministral3-8B.
recent_models.qmd_compatibility_status: No official GGUF in inspected publisher repo. QMD2.8.3 loads local GGUF via node-llama-cpp and formats inputs as Gemma/nomic or Qwen3, whereas this model requires query:/passage: prefixes and mean pooling. A local vLLM endpoint is not automatically used by QMD’s local adapter.
recent_models.practical_assessment: 1B is the strongest practical recent dense-embedding candidate for a separately supported local retrieval service;8B is a heavier quality-oriented option, not a default PC upgrade.
